metadata.name: Voice Clone Tool
metadata.description: Tool registry integration for voice cloning and speech synthesis using Coqui TTS with XTTS v2, YourTTS, and FreeVC models
metadata.author: automated-developer

globalContext.license: MPL-2.0 (code), Coqui Public Model License (XTTS models)
globalContext.supportedLanguages: en, es, fr, de, it, pt, pl, tr, ru, nl, cs, ar, zh-cn, ja, hu, ko, hi (17 languages)

goals.objective: Initialize Python project with Coqui TTS and required dependencies for voice cloning

success: Project structure with pyproject.toml or requirements.txt
TTS package installed via pip install TTS
PyTorch with CUDA support for GPU acceleration
Audio processing dependencies: scipy, soundfile, librosa
acceptance: GPU detection works if CUDA available

constraints: Minimum 4GB VRAM for XTTS v2, 8GB+ recommended

context.pipInstall: pip install TTS torch torchaudio scipy soundfile

goals.objective: Implement model download, caching, and lifecycle management for TTS models

success: list_models() returns all available TTS and vocoder models
load_model(name, device) loads model to CPU or GPU

goals.objective: Implement core voice cloning functionality using XTTS v2 with speaker embedding extraction

success: Supports single or multiple reference audio files
Cross-language cloning (clone English voice, speak French)
acceptance: Output quality matches reference speaker characteristics

constraints: Reference audio should be clean speech without background noise
gpt_cond_len parameter affects quality vs speed

context.gptCondLen: 3-6 seconds of conditioning audio used (gpt_cond_len parameter)

goals.objective: Implement voice conversion to transform existing audio to target speaker voice using FreeVC

success: Preserves speech content while changing speaker identity
Combinable with TTS for any-model cloning
acceptance: FreeVC24 model loads and runs inference

constraints: Source and target audio should be similar duration for best results
Works best with clear speech recordings

goals.objective: Implement speaker embedding extraction, storage, and retrieval for voice profile management

acceptance: Embeddings stored in standard voice directory
Compatible with Coqui TTS voice caching (v0.27+)
Metadata includes model version, source files, timestamp

constraints: Embeddings are model-specific (XTTS, YourTTS have different formats)
Store original reference audio paths for audit

context.embeddingFormat: NPZ or pickle containing gpt_conditioning_latents and speaker_embedding

goals.objective: Implement audio preprocessing for reference audio validation and normalization

acceptance: Converts to WAV 22050Hz mono if needed
Warns about background noise or music

constraints: Use librosa or soundfile for audio processing
Preserve original audio, output normalized copy

context.qualityChecks: SNR estimation, clipping detection, silence ratio

goals.objective: Implement streaming TTS synthesis for real-time audio generation with low latency
Implement multi-speaker synthesis with voice interpolation and speaker switching
constraints: Speaker interpolation only within same model family
Preset speakers from XTTS training data

context.presetSpeakers: Ana Florence, Craig Gutsy, etc. (XTTS built-in)
context.listSpeakers: tts.speakers property returns available preset speakers

goals.objective: Define JSON schema for voice_clone tool interface with comprehensive input/output specifications

success: Input schema: action, text, reference_audio, language, speaker_id, model, output_path
Output schema: audio_path, duration_ms, sample_rate, speaker_id
Action types: clone, convert, synthesize, extract_speaker, list_speakers, list_models
acceptance: Schema validates with JSON Schema Draft-07

constraints: reference_audio accepts file path or base64 encoded audio
Support both file output and base64 audio response

context.actions: clone | convert | synthesize | extract_speaker | list_speakers | list_models | list_languages
context.languageCodes: en, es, fr, de, it, pt, pl, tr, ru, nl, cs, ar, zh-cn, ja, hu, ko, hi

goals.objective: Implement tool registry handler for JSON request processing and voice cloning dispatch

success: clone action generates speech with cloned voice
synthesize action uses cached speaker or preset
acceptance: All actions return valid JSON per schema

constraints: Model loading may be slow on first request
Implement request queuing for resource management

goals.objective: Create CLI binary for standalone voice_clone tool invocation
constraints: Use argparse or click for CLI

context.cliCommands: clone, convert, synthesize, extract, speakers, models, languages, serve
context.serveCommand: voice-clone serve --port 5002 starts HTTP API server

goals.objective: Implement HTTP API server for voice cloning service deployment

success: POST /clone accepts JSON with text, reference_audio, language
POST /convert accepts source and target audio

context.framework: FastAPI recommended for async and OpenAPI

goals.objective: Implement XTTS fine-tuning workflow for custom voice training

success: fine_tune(dataset, config) trains custom voice model

constraints: Uses GPT encoder training only (not full model)

goals.objective: Implement safety measures to prevent misuse of voice cloning capabilities

success: Consent verification for voice cloning requests
acceptance: Consent flag required for new voice enrollment

constraints: Follow Coqui Public Model License terms

context.watermarkMethod: Imperceptible audio watermark or metadata embedding

goals.objective: Write comprehensive tests for voice cloning, conversion, and speaker management

success: Integration tests for model loading and inference
acceptance: Tests pass on CPU and GPU

context.mockStrategy: Mock TTS model for unit tests, real model for integration
context.performanceMetrics: Inference time, memory usage, RTF (real-time factor)

goals.objective: Write comprehensive documentation for voice cloning tool usage and API

success: README with installation, quick start, examples
acceptance: Covers all supported models and languages

context.sections: Overview, Installation, Quick Start, CLI Reference, HTTP API, Voice Quality Tips, Models, Languages, Fine-tuning, Safety, Troubleshooting

goals.objective: Package voice_clone tool for registration with tool registry
constraints: Large model files require pre-download or first-use download

context.manifestDescription: Voice cloning and speech synthesis using Coqui TTS XTTS v2
